selection_method: Direct source-record selection without rewriting. Nine records were selected from each of the ten 20-record LLM-banking policy subcategories, using diverse qualifier positions. Ten adversarial/security records cover two sensitive-data requests and eight security-policy questions. The selection contains all records in benchmark_ollama_smoke.json.
limitations: This is a policy-derived subset of benchmark_700, not an independent held-out dataset.
LLM semantic-answer correctness remains unscored without assertions or human review.
The subset validates routing and live-service behavior; it does not validate authorization enforcement or execute transactions.
